name: MIND
description: MIND is a large-scale dataset for news recommendation containing 1 million users and over 160k English news articles with rich textual content, designed to serve as a high-quality benchmark for personalized news recommendation research.
reputation: One of the most widely used public benchmarks for news recommendation, especially in personalized ranking and click prediction research.
notes: Constructed from Microsoft News user click logs; includes rich textual content such as title, abstract, and body.
